description: Single, wages and interest, starts from federal taxable income
working: IA 1040: line 1 federal taxable income = 72,000 - 16,100 = 55,900; no Schedule 1 modifications -> Iowa taxable income 55,900. Tax = 55,900 x 3.8% = 2,124.20. Exemption credit: 1 personal credit x $40 = 40. Tax after credits = 2,124.20 - 40 = 2,084.20.

description: Joint, both 65+, one other dependent: federal senior deduction flows through federal taxable income; $40/$20 exemption credits
working: Federal: AGI 100,000; standard 32,200 + 2 x 1,650 = 35,500; senior deduction 2 x 6,000 = 12,000 (MAGI below 150,000); taxable = 100,000 - 35,500 - 12,000 = 52,500. IA 1040: Iowa taxable income = federal taxable income 52,500 (rolling conformity, no modifications). Tax = 52,500 x 3.8% = 1,995. Exemption credits: 2 personal x 40 + 1 dependent x 40 + 2 age-65 x 20 = 80 + 40 + 40 = 160. Tax = 1,995 - 160 = 1,835.
